name: Human Adipose Tissue Atlas v1.0 — All cells
description: Integrated single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas including data from ASAT, AVAT, and CSAT depots.

labelsets.name: lvl2_cell_types
labelsets.description: Level 2 cell type labels (represents broad clusters most studies tend to identify).

labels.name: ECs
labels.rationale: PECAM1 (CD31) and CDH5 (VE-cadherin) are pan-endothelial markers present across all endothelial subtypes. MECOM and ENPEP further confirm endothelial identity. Together these markers define the endothelial cell compartment encompassing capillary, arterial, venous, and lymphatic EC subtypes.

labels.name: Adipocytes
labels.rationale: ADIPOQ and PLIN1 are established markers of mature adipocytes. ADIPOQ (adiponectin) is a hormone abundantly and selectively expressed by differentiated adipocytes and reflects their metabolic and endocrine function. PLIN1 (perilipin-1) is a lipid droplet–associated protein essential for lipid storage and lipolysis regulation, marking cells with mature adipocyte morphology. ADIPOQ and PLIN1 reliably identify differentiated adipocytes and distinguish them from stromal and progenitor cell populations.

labels.name: ASPCs
labels.rationale: PDGFRA and DCN (decorin) are pan-ASPC markers broadly expressed across all adipose stromal and progenitor cell subpopulations. Together these markers define the ASPC compartment encompassing DPP4⁺, EPHA3⁺, IGFBP2⁺, PPARG⁺, and TENM2⁺ subtypes.
synonyms: mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue

labels.name: Mast cells
labels.rationale: KIT (CD117) is a receptor tyrosine kinase broadly used to identify mast cells across tissues. CPA3 (carboxypeptidase A3) is a mast cell-specific serine protease stored in secretory granules. Together these markers reliably identify mast cells and distinguish them from other immune cell populations.

labels.name: Dendritic cells
labels.rationale: FLT3 is a pan-dendritic cell marker expressed across DC progenitors and mature DC subsets. Together with clustering context, FLT3 defines the dendritic cell compartment encompassing cDC1, cDC2B, activated DC, pDC, and proliferating DC subtypes.

labels.name: Macrophages & Monocytes
labels.rationale: MRC1 (CD206) and F13A1 are broadly expressed across tissue-resident macrophage populations, while FCN1 (ficolin-1) shows enriched expression in monocyte populations. Together these markers define the macrophage and monocyte compartment encompassing LAMs, PVMs, inflammatory macrophages, proliferating macrophages, classical monocytes, non-classical monocytes, and CD14⁺S100A8/9⁺ monocytes.

labels.name: B cells
labels.rationale: MS4A1 (CD20) and CD79A confirm B cell lineage identity, with IGKC reflecting active immunoglobulin expression. JCHAIN and MZB1 mark antibody-secreting plasma cells, which are included in this compartment as terminally differentiated B cell-derived populations. Together these markers define the B cell compartment encompassing naive B cells and plasma cells.

labels.name: Mesothelial cells
labels.rationale: MSLN (mesothelin) is a glycoprotein highly expressed on the surface of mesothelial cells lining serous cavities. KRT19 (cytokeratin 19) is an epithelial intermediate filament protein characteristic of mesothelial and epithelial lineages. BNC1 (basonuclin-1) marks mesothelial identity and distinguishes these cells from endothelial and stromal populations. Together, these markers reliably identify mesothelial cells in adipose tissue.

labels.name: Neuron-associated cells
labels.rationale: NA

labels.name: T & NK cells
labels.rationale: CD3D and CD3E are components of the T cell receptor signaling complex, confirming T cell lineage identity across all T cell subpopulations. NCR1 (NKp46) and NCAM1 (CD56) confirm NK cell lineage identity. Together these markers define the T and NK cell compartment encompassing CD4⁺, CD8⁺, regulatory, MAIT, proliferating T cells, ILC3s, and CD56⁺CD16⁺ and CD56⁺CD16⁻ NK cell subtypes.

labels.name: Mural cells
labels.rationale: STEAP4 and COL25A1 show enriched expression in pericytes in adipose tissue single-cell datasets. MYOCD (myocardin) and MYH11 (smooth muscle myosin heavy chain) identify smooth muscle cells. Together these markers define the mural cell compartment encompassing pericytes and smooth muscle cells.

labels.name: Capillary ECs
labels.rationale: PECAM1 (CD31) and CDH5 (VE-cadherin) are pan-endothelial markers essential for cell-cell adhesion and vascular integrity, present across all endothelial subtypes. MECOM and ENPEP further confirm endothelial identity. BTNL9, RBP7, and CA4 are enriched in capillary endothelial cells specifically, with CA4 (carbonic anhydrase 4) being a well-established capillary EC marker in adipose tissue. Together these markers identify capillary ECs and distinguish them from arterial, venous, and lymphatic endothelial subtypes.

labels.name: Adipocytes
labels.rationale: ADIPOQ and PLIN1 are established markers of mature adipocytes. ADIPOQ (adiponectin) is a hormone abundantly and selectively expressed by differentiated adipocytes and reflects their metabolic and endocrine function. PLIN1 (perilipin-1) is a lipid droplet–associated protein essential for lipid storage and lipolysis regulation, marking cells with mature adipocyte morphology. ADIPOQ and PLIN1 reliably identify differentiated adipocytes and distinguish them from stromal and progenitor cell populations.

labels.name: IGFBP2⁺ ASPCs
labels.rationale: PDGFRA and DCN (decorin) are general ASPC/stromal markers broadly expressed across adipose stromal and progenitor cell populations. IGFBP2 (insulin-like growth factor binding protein 2) shows enriched expression in this specific subpopulation and marks a depot-restricted population found exclusively in visceral adipose tissue (AVAT), distinguishing IGFBP2⁺ ASPCs from other ASPC subtypes present across depots. Together these markers identify a visceral-specific ASPC subpopulation within the broader stromal compartment.
synonyms: mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue

labels.name: Mast cells
labels.rationale: KIT (CD117) is a receptor tyrosine kinase broadly used to identify mast cells across tissues. CPA3 (carboxypeptidase A3) is a mast cell-specific serine protease stored in secretory granules. Together these markers reliably identify mast cells and distinguish them from other immune cell populations.

labels.name: cDC2B
labels.rationale: FLT3 is a general dendritic cell marker expressed across DC progenitors and mature DC subsets. FCER1A (high-affinity IgE receptor), CD1C, CLEC10A, and IRF4 show enriched expression in cDC2s specifically, with IRF4 being a transcription factor involved in cDC2 differentiation and function. Together these markers identify cDC2B and distinguish them from cDC1 and other dendritic cell subsets.

labels.name: CD14⁺CD16⁺ Monocytes
labels.rationale: FCN1 (ficolin-1) is a pattern recognition molecule with enriched expression in monocytes broadly. FCGR3A (CD16), HES4, LST1, and DGKG show enriched expression in CD14⁺CD16⁺ non-classical monocytes specifically, with FCGR3A being the defining surface marker of this subset. Together these markers identify the non-classical monocyte subset and distinguish them from classical monocyte populations.

labels.name: pDC
labels.rationale: CLEC4C (BDCA-2) and LILRA4 (BDCA-4) are surface markers with enriched expression in plasmacytoid dendritic cells. IL3RA (CD123) further supports pDC identity. TCF4, IRF7, and IRF8 are transcription factors involved in pDC specification and function, with IRF7 playing a role in type I interferon production characteristic of this population. NRP1 (neuropilin-1) shows enriched expression in pDCs across tissues. Together these markers identify plasmacytoid dendritic cells and distinguish them from conventional DC subsets.

labels.name: B cells
labels.rationale: MS4A1 (CD20) is a surface marker broadly expressed on mature B cells. CD79A is a component of the B cell receptor signaling complex and confirms B cell lineage identity. IGKC (immunoglobulin kappa constant) reflects active immunoglobulin expression characteristic of B cells. Together these markers reliably identify B cells and distinguish them from other lymphoid populations.

labels.name: cDC1
labels.rationale: FLT3 is a general dendritic cell marker expressed across DC progenitors and mature DC subsets. XCR1, CLEC9A (DNGR-1), CADM1, and DPP4 show enriched expression in cDC1s specifically, with XCR1 and CLEC9A being well-characterized surface markers of this subset involved in cross-presentation of antigens. Together these markers identify cDC1s and distinguish them from cDC2 and other dendritic cell subsets.

labels.name: CD14⁺CD16⁻ Monocytes
labels.rationale: FCN1 (ficolin-1) is a pattern recognition molecule with enriched expression in classical monocytes. FCER1A, TXNIP (thioredoxin interacting protein), and FCAR (Fc alpha receptor, CD89) show enriched expression in CD14⁺CD16⁻ classical monocytes specifically. Together these markers identify the classical monocyte subset and distinguish them from non-classical and intermediate monocyte populations.

labels.name: Activated DCs
labels.rationale: FLT3 is a general dendritic cell marker expressed across DC progenitors and mature DC subsets. CCR7, FSCN1, CCL22, and LAMP3 show enriched expression in activated/migratory DCs, reflecting an activation and maturation state rather than a fixed DC subset identity. Together these markers identify a transcriptionally distinct activated DC population and distinguish them from resident cDC1 and cDC2 subsets.

labels.name: Plasma cells
labels.rationale: JCHAIN (joining chain) is a component of polymeric immunoglobulins and is highly expressed in antibody-secreting cells. MZB1 (marginal zone B and B1 cell-specific protein) is an endoplasmic reticulum protein involved in immunoglobulin secretion, enriched in plasmablasts and plasma cells. Together these markers identify antibody-secreting plasma cells and distinguish them from naive and memory B cell populations.

labels.name: CD14⁺S100A8/9⁺ Monocytes
labels.rationale: FCN1 (ficolin-1) is a pattern recognition molecule with enriched expression in monocytes broadly. S100A8 and S100A9 (calprotectin subunits) show highly enriched expression in this specific subset, marking an inflammatory monocyte state associated with innate immune activation. Together these markers identify a transcriptionally distinct CD14⁺S100A8/9⁺ monocyte population and distinguish them from classical and non-classical monocyte subsets.

labels.name: Neutrophils
labels.rationale: S100A12 and S100A9 are calcium-binding proteins highly expressed in neutrophils and reflect their inflammatory state. CSF3R (CD114, G-CSF receptor) is a surface receptor involved in neutrophil development and survival. CXCR2 is a chemokine receptor mediating neutrophil recruitment to sites of inflammation, and FCGR3B (CD16b) is a neutrophil-specific isoform of CD16 distinguishing neutrophils from NK cells and monocytes that express FCGR3A. Together these markers reliably identify neutrophils and distinguish them from other myeloid cell populations.

labels.name: PVMs
labels.rationale: MRC1 (CD206) and F13A1 are general macrophage markers broadly expressed across tissue-resident macrophage populations. LYVE1, SELENOP (selenoprotein P), and C1QA show enriched expression in perivascular macrophages specifically, with LYVE1 marking macrophages associated with the perivascular niche. Together these markers identify perivascular macrophages (PVMs) and distinguish them from other macrophage subpopulations including LAMs.

labels.name: LAMs
labels.rationale: MRC1 (CD206) and F13A1 are general macrophage markers broadly expressed across tissue-resident macrophage populations. CD9, TREM2, and LPL (lipoprotein lipase) show enriched expression in lipid-associated macrophages specifically, with TREM2 being a receptor involved in lipid sensing and metabolism. Together these markers identify lipid-associated macrophages (LAMs) and distinguish them from other macrophage subpopulations.

labels.name: Proliferating macrophages
labels.rationale: MRC1 (CD206) is a general macrophage marker confirming macrophage identity. MKI67 (Ki-67) is a marker of active cell proliferation. Together these markers identify a proliferating macrophage population rather than a transcriptionally distinct macrophage subset.

labels.name: Proliferating DCs
labels.rationale: FLT3 is a general dendritic cell marker confirming DC identity. TOP2A (topoisomerase II alpha) is a marker of actively proliferating cells. Together these markers identify a proliferating DC population rather than a transcriptionally distinct DC subset.

labels.name: Mesothelial cells
labels.rationale: MSLN (mesothelin) is a glycoprotein highly expressed on the surface of mesothelial cells lining serous cavities. KRT19 (cytokeratin 19) is an epithelial intermediate filament protein characteristic of mesothelial and epithelial lineages. BNC1 (basonuclin-1) marks mesothelial identity and distinguishes these cells from endothelial and stromal populations. Together, these markers reliably identify mesothelial cells in adipose tissue.

labels.name: Peripheral neurons
labels.rationale: NA

labels.name: CD4⁺ T cells
labels.rationale: CD3D and CD3E are components of the T cell receptor signaling complex, confirming T cell lineage identity. CD4 is a surface co-receptor defining the CD4⁺ T cell lineage. CD2 is a surface adhesion molecule broadly expressed on T cells and NK cells, supporting T cell activation. CD40LG (CD40 ligand) is expressed on activated CD4⁺ T cells and is involved in T cell-B cell interactions. Together these markers identify CD4⁺ T cells and distinguish them from CD8⁺ and regulatory T cell populations.

labels.name: Cytotoxic CD8⁺ T cells
labels.rationale: CD8A confirms CD8⁺ T cell lineage identity. PRF1 (perforin-1) and GZMB (granzyme B) are cytotoxic effector molecules stored in cytotoxic granules and are characteristic of cells with cytotoxic activity. CX3CR1 (fractalkine receptor) shows enriched expression in terminally differentiated cytotoxic T cells and is associated with effector memory and tissue-patrolling states. Together these markers identify cytotoxic CD8⁺ T cells and distinguish them from naive and memory CD8⁺ T cell populations.

labels.name: EPHA3⁺ ASPCs
labels.rationale: PDGFRA and DCN (decorin) are general ASPC/stromal markers broadly expressed across adipose stromal and progenitor cell populations. EPHA3 (ephrin type-A receptor 3) is the defining marker of this subpopulation, distinguishing EPHA3⁺ ASPCs from other ASPC subtypes. This population resembles an adipogenesis-regulatory cell population previously reported in mice. Together these markers identify a distinct ASPC subpopulation within the broader stromal compartment.
synonyms: mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue

labels.name: TENM2⁺ ASPCs
labels.rationale: DCN (decorin) is a stromal/fibroblast marker broadly expressed in connective tissue. TENM2 (teneurin-2) is a transmembrane protein involved in neural circuit organization and cell-cell signaling. SLC22A3 is an organic cation transporter with enriched expression in specific stromal subpopulations. ITGA6 (integrin alpha-6) marks cells associated with basement membrane adhesion and has been found enriched in fibroblasts surrounding peripheral nerves in tendon and muscle, suggesting a perineural identity. Together, these markers characterize a stromal/ASPC subpopulation with perineural localization, here referred to as TENM2⁺ ASPCs.
synonyms: mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue

labels.name: Memory CD4⁺ T cells
labels.rationale: CD4 is a surface co-receptor confirming CD4⁺ T cell lineage identity. LEF1 (lymphoid enhancer binding factor 1) is a transcription factor associated with memory T cell states. ITGB1 (integrin beta-1) is involved in T cell adhesion and tissue retention, with enriched expression in memory T cell populations. Together these markers identify memory CD4⁺ T cells and distinguish them from naive and effector CD4⁺ T cell populations.

labels.name: Lymphatic ECs
labels.rationale: PECAM1 (CD31) and CDH5 (VE-cadherin) are pan-endothelial markers confirming endothelial identity, while MECOM and ENPEP further support this. PROX1 is a transcription factor required for lymphatic endothelial cell specification and maintenance, and LYVE1 (lymphatic vessel endothelial hyaluronan receptor 1) is expressed on the surface of lymphatic endothelial cells and involved in hyaluronan uptake. Together these markers identify lymphatic ECs and distinguish them from capillary, arterial, and venous endothelial subtypes.

labels.name: PPARG⁺ ASPCs
labels.rationale: PDGFRA and DCN (decorin) are general ASPC/stromal markers broadly expressed across adipose stromal and progenitor cell populations. PPARG (peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma) shows enriched expression in this specific subpopulation, distinguishing PPARG⁺ ASPCs from other ASPC subtypes. Together these markers identify a distinct ASPC subpopulation within the broader stromal compartment.
synonyms: mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue

labels.name: SMCs
labels.rationale: MYOCD (myocardin) is a transcription factor driving smooth muscle cell differentiation and is enriched in smooth muscle cells. MYH11 (smooth muscle myosin heavy chain) is a contractile protein with enriched expression in mature smooth muscle cells. Together these markers reliably identify smooth muscle cells within the mural cell compartment and distinguish them from pericytes and other stromal populations.

labels.name: DPP4⁺ ASPCs
labels.rationale: PDGFRA and DCN (decorin) are general ASPC/stromal markers broadly expressed across adipose stromal and progenitor cell populations. DPP4 (dipeptidyl peptidase 4), CD55 (decay accelerating factor), and PI16 (peptidase inhibitor 16) show enriched expression in this specific subpopulation, together distinguishing DPP4⁺ ASPCs from other ASPC subtypes. Together these markers identify a distinct ASPC subpopulation within the broader stromal compartment.
synonyms: mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue

labels.name: Pericytes
labels.rationale: STEAP4 (STEAP family member 4) and COL25A1 (collagen type XXV alpha 1) show enriched expression in pericytes in single-nucleus adipose tissue datasets, and are used here to identify this population. Together these markers identify pericytes within the mural cell compartment and distinguish them from smooth muscle cells and stromal populations in adipose tissue.

labels.name: CD8⁺ T cells
labels.rationale: CD3D and CD3E are components of the T cell receptor signaling complex, confirming T cell lineage identity. CD8A is a surface co-receptor defining the CD8⁺ T cell lineage and distinguishing these cells from CD4⁺ T cells. Together these markers reliably identify CD8⁺ T cells within the T cell compartment.

labels.name: Venous ECs
labels.rationale: PECAM1 (CD31) and CDH5 (VE-cadherin) are pan-endothelial markers confirming endothelial identity, while MECOM and ENPEP further support this. ACKR1 (atypical chemokine receptor 1, also known as DARC) shows enriched expression in venous endothelial cells and is involved in chemokine scavenging. Together these markers identify venous ECs and distinguish them from capillary, arterial, and lymphatic endothelial subtypes.

labels.name: Schwann cells
labels.rationale: XKR4 shows enriched expression in Schwann cells and is used here to identify this population within the neuron-associated cell compartment.

labels.name: Mucosal-associated invariant T cells
labels.rationale: CD3D and CD3E are components of the T cell receptor signaling complex, confirming T cell lineage identity. CD8A confirms a cytotoxic T cell co-receptor expression profile. KLRB1 (CD161) and SLC4A10 are enriched in mucosal-associated invariant T cells (MAITs) specifically, with SLC4A10 being a well-characterized MAIT cell marker involved in bicarbonate transport. Together these markers identify MAIT cells and distinguish them from conventional CD8⁺ and CD4⁺ T cell populations.

labels.name: Treg cells
labels.rationale: CD3D and CD3E are components of the T cell receptor signaling complex, confirming T cell lineage identity. FOXP3 is a transcription factor required for regulatory T cell specification and function, and is the defining marker of this population. TIGIT and CTLA4 are inhibitory receptors enriched in regulatory T cells, reflecting their immunosuppressive function. Together these markers reliably identify regulatory T cells (Tregs) and distinguish them from conventional CD4⁺ and CD8⁺ T cell populations.

labels.name: CD56⁺CD16⁺ NK cells
labels.fullName: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human
labels.ontologyTerm: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human
labels.rationale: NCR1 (NKp46) and NCAM1 (CD56) confirm NK cell lineage identity. GNLY (granulysin), PRF1 (perforin-1), and KLRD1 (CD94) reflect cytotoxic capacity broadly shared across NK cell populations. FCGR3A (CD16) defines the CD16⁺ subset and is involved in antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity. FGFBP2 and KLRF1 show enriched expression in this mature cytotoxic NK cell subset in adipose tissue single-cell datasets. Together these markers identify CD56⁺CD16⁺ NK cells and distinguish them from CD16⁻ NK cell populations.

labels.name: CD56⁺CD16⁻ NK cells
labels.fullName: CD16-negative, CD56-bright natural killer cell, human
labels.ontologyTerm: CD16-negative, CD56-bright natural killer cell, human
labels.rationale: NCR1 (NKp46) and NCAM1 (CD56) confirm NK cell lineage identity. This population is defined by the absence of FCGR3A (CD16) expression, distinguishing it from the more cytotoxic CD56⁺CD16⁺ NK cell subset. Together these markers identify CD56⁺CD16⁻ NK cells within the broader NK cell compartment.
synonyms: CD56-bright cytokine secreting natural killer cell

labels.name: Proliferating T cells
labels.rationale: CD3D and CD3E are components of the T cell receptor signaling complex, confirming T cell lineage identity. MKI67 (Ki-67) is a marker of active cell proliferation. Together these markers identify a proliferating T cell population rather than a transcriptionally distinct T cell subset.

labels.name: ILC3
labels.rationale: IL7R (CD127) is broadly expressed on innate lymphoid cells and confirms ILC lineage identity. CD200R1 shows enriched expression in ILC3s and has been reported as a marker of this population in the literature. Together these markers identify ILC3s within the innate lymphoid cell compartment and distinguish them from other ILC subsets and conventional T cells.

labels.name: CD56⁺CD16⁻ Immature NK cells
labels.rationale: NCR1 (NKp46) and NCAM1 (CD56) confirm NK cell lineage identity. IL7R (CD127) and SELL (CD62L) show enriched expression in immature and less differentiated NK cells, with SELL being associated with lymph node homing and an immature NK cell state. Together these markers identify immature NK cells and distinguish them from mature CD56⁺CD16⁺ and CD56⁺CD16⁻ NK cell populations.

labels.name: Arterial ECs
labels.rationale: PECAM1 (CD31) and CDH5 (VE-cadherin) are pan-endothelial markers confirming endothelial identity, while MECOM and ENPEP further support this. PCSK5, GJA5 (connexin 40), and NEBL show enriched expression in arterial endothelial cells, with GJA5 mediating gap junction communication characteristic of arterial vessels. Together these markers identify arterial ECs and distinguish them from capillary, venous, and lymphatic endothelial subtypes.

labels.name: Inflammatory macrophages
labels.rationale: MRC1 (CD206) and F13A1 are general macrophage markers broadly expressed across tissue-resident macrophage populations. CCL3L1, TNF (tumor necrosis factor), and CXCL3 show enriched expression in inflammatory macrophages, reflecting a pro-inflammatory activation state rather than a fixed macrophage subset identity. Together these markers identify a transcriptionally distinct inflammatory macrophage population and distinguish them from resident macrophage subpopulations such as LAMs and PVMs.
